items.summary: Recommendation: continue the active reversible work on fishhooklabs.com, allthingsmasonic.com, and americastrikes.com, and correct the failed 0daynews.com task routing. The 30-day SEO window shows fishhooklabs.com at 138 impressions, position 9.3, and 2 clicks; Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. Site-level margin and ROI are not calculable because one tracking ID is unmapped and direct costs are unavailable. The main unknown is whether the active changes improve qualified clicks and attributable revenue. Smallest next step: complete the existing baselines, apply bounded changes, run smoke/link checks, and measure after 14 days or 100 new impressions. Owner question: for SearchWoot choose (A) prepare an unsent Woot permission request, (B) keep private with no outreach, or (C) stop pursuing public beta.
